import sys,os,json,hashlib,threading,unittest
from pathlib import Path
from omnis_cli import model_relay,forwarder,model_relay_protocol
expected={'omnis_cli.model_relay':'05c146e6ab33de212d7aa4d688a842ff806d58783776316ef29e7758d60134c5','omnis_cli.forwarder':'56e5aa4335f7b9185d81d462741cbc3adb370eca688657f1ede5e56ce65015f0','omnis_cli.model_relay_protocol':'673af60bca073d8fd0787bf8ad3f7f64f946601d0cddfa4601a1ed99cc568365'}
origins={m.__name__:{'file':str(Path(m.__file__).resolve()),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(m.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for m in [model_relay,forwarder,model_relay_protocol]}
assert all(info['sha256']==expected[name] for name,info in origins.items())
if sys.argv[1]=='installed':
 assert all('/ucr-bwdnxpls/omnis-p04-cli-check/lib/python3.13/site-packages/' in info['file'] for info in origins.values())
 assert '/home/kali/OmnisAI/cli/src' not in sys.path
else:assert all(info['file'].startswith('/home/kali/OmnisAI/cli/src/') for info in origins.values())
sys.path.insert(0,'/home/kali/OmnisAI/cli/tests')
import test_model_relay_fence
assert str(Path(test_model_relay_fence.__file__).resolve())=='/home/kali/OmnisAI/cli/tests/test_model_relay_fence.py'
print(json.dumps({'mode':sys.argv[1],'python':sys.version.split()[0],'executable':sys.executable,'cwd':os.getcwd(),'origins':origins,'test_file':test_model_relay_fence.__file__}),flush=True)
suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName('test_model_relay_fence.PhysicalFenceTest.test_fence_held_dns_denies_late_connect_and_drain_waits_for_resolver')
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
remaining=[t for t in threading.enumerate() if t.name=='omnis-model-dns' and t.is_alive()]
assert not remaining
print(json.dumps({'testsRun':result.testsRun,'successful':result.wasSuccessful(),'owned_dns_threads_remaining':len(remaining),'config_empty':not any(Path(os.environ['XDG_CONFIG_HOME']).iterdir())}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
